answer:
Based on the NCES IPEDS data from the Nebraska Higher Education Progress Report, here are the **full-time first-year to second-year retention rates** for Nebraska institutions with "Community College" in their name for the Fall 2022 to Fall 2023 period:

| Institution | First-Year Students | Retained | Retention Rate |
|-------------|-------------------|----------|----------------|
| Northeast Community College | 894 | 652 | **73%** |
| Mid-Plains Community College | 238 | 169 | 71% |
| Central Community College | 580 | 391 | 67% |
| Southeast Community College | 1,067 | 683 | 64% |
| Metropolitan Community College Area | 532 | 329 | 62% |
| Western Nebraska Community College | 243 | 121 | 50% |

## Answer: **Northeast Community College** had the highest first-to-second year retention rate among full-time students from Fall 2022 to Fall 2023, with a retention rate of **73%**.

Mid-Plains Community College is a public institution in North Platte, Nebraska. Its campus is located in a town with a total enrollment of 2,075. The school utilizes a semester-based academic year. Students can earn degrees and certificates in 20 different fields. Popular programs include: Liberal Arts and Sciences/Liberal Studies, Registered Nursing/Registered Nurse, and Business Administration and Management, General.
